question: Terragrunt v1.0.0 (2026-03-30) renamed much of the CLI. SKILL.md's first hard policy bans every pre-1.0 form. Does stating the ban change what the model emits?
note: Model-in-the-loop ablation, not a script eval. Run: uv run evals/build_arms.py && ./evals/matrix.sh && uv run evals/grade.py. Grading is by banned-form detection with a mandatory human adjudication step -- 'run-all was removed in 1.0' is correct behaviour and must not score as a violation. `uv run evals/grade.py --final` refuses to report until every hit has a verdict. Detection and classification are tested in tests/test_eval_grade.py.

arms.name: control
arms.isolates: the null hypothesis -- the model unaided

arms.name: policy-ablated
arms.isolates: everything the skill knows except the ban

design.replicates_rationale: A between-arm gap is unreadable without knowing how much two runs of the same arm disagree. grade.py prints that noise floor beside every result.
design.third_arm_rationale: C vs S alone cannot separate the ban from the surrounding 2,000 words of correct 1.x context. S-P isolates the ban; C-P isolates the rest.
design.no_json_schema: A forced schema overrides output shape, and this suite grades the CLI and HCL actually emitted.

cases.asks: plan across thirty modules in one go
format every .hcl in the repo, wire it into pre-commit
check passed inputs match the module's variables
child inherits backend and provider from the top of the tree
leave one unit out of a whole-tree run
retry transient AWS throttling in CI
point at a directory and a non-default config from CI

out_of_scope: The ten reference files are NOT inlined -- the harness disallows Read and Grep, and the references total ~31,000 words. This bounds the effect of SKILL.md, where the hard policy lives. It says nothing about reference quality.
Not a correctness test. An answer can score clean and still be wrong.
Version gating (does the skill refuse a v1.1.0+ attribute for a repo pinned to <=1.0.x) is a separate suite.
Diagnosis accuracy needs a judge model and real error text; no cloud or backend is connected here. If built, must run offline against captured strings.
